column5: The implementation of GHG reduction targets can reinforce biodiversity protection and conservation efforts by reducing pollution and promoting sustainable land use practices, which in turn can help protect and restore ecosystems and biodiversity.
Reducing GHG emissions can also improve air quality by decreasing the amount of air pollutants released into the atmosphere, which can have positive impacts on human health and the environment.

Furthermore, reducing GHG emissions can help improve water quality by decreasing the amount of pollutants released into water bodies, which can have positive impacts on aquatic ecosystems and human health.

The implementation of GHG reduction targets can also reinforce efforts to improve soil health by promoting sustainable agriculture practices and reducing soil pollution, which can help maintain soil fertility and support ecosystem services.

Reducing GHG emissions can enable efforts to reduce noise pollution by promoting the use of cleaner and quieter technologies, such as electric vehicles, which can help reduce noise pollution in urban areas.

Additionally, reducing GHG emissions can enable efforts to improve sanitation and public health by providing access to clean water and sanitation facilities, which can help reduce the spread of diseases and improve overall public health.
